subject: general
question:
In the adjoining figure AB || CD and CD || EF. Also, EA ⊥ AB. If ∠BGD = 62°, then the value of w is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf4aa173f0fd706e2b841536729cc8171ab5f8eafc78766872ff5bd96784cdbe.png]
solution:
**Given:**

Here AB || CD ,CD || EF and EA ⊥ AB. 

therefore FE⊥ EA 

BGE is a transverse line.

∠BGD = 62°

∠GEC = w

**Concept used:**

 
• Parallel lines are lines that are lying on the same plane but will never meet.
 
• The transversal line cuts two lines that is line which pass through both parallel lines.
 
• **Complementary angles are two angles with a sum of 90°** . A common case is when they form a right angle.
 
• Angles formed when a transversal line cuts across two straight lines are known as **corresponding angles they are equal angles.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40529c7a5e55e9f024c8ccd391234625d6174a58424d4d503027e94ca1816d97.png] 

**Calculation:**

Here line FE || DC and line BGE is a transverse line .

⇒∠GEF=∠BGD (corresponding angles)

⇒∠GEF= 62°

As given line FE ⊥ EA,

⇒∠EFA = 90° (perpendicular angle is of 90°)

⇒∠FEG + ∠GEC =90°

⇒ 62° + ∠GEC =90°

⇒ ∠GEC =28°

**Hence, the value of w is 28°.**
